How we work
Challenge Capability Creativity Openness
OUR VALUES

01

CHALLENGE

Let’s give it a go. We take on something new, learn as we go, and use what we learn on the next try.

02

CAPABILITY

Good at it. Getting better. We build on what we know and learn from the people we work with.

03

CREATIVITY

Another way? We’re interested. We make room for ideas that take a different approach, even when they’re still taking shape.

04

OPENNESS

Speak freely. We’re listening. You don’t have to agree with everyone to be heard here.
